source: AWS us-east-1 on-demand list-price snapshot, maintained by hand. Verify the current price before approving spend.
notes: gp3 storage is USD 0.08/GiB-month in us-east-1; throughput above 125 MB/s and IOPS above 3,000 are billed separately.
Every node gets a public IPv4 address for SSH and operator access; AWS bills public IPv4 addresses per hour.
The estimate excludes data transfer, snapshots, backups, object storage, taxes and support. Intra-VPC traffic is free while the cluster stays in one availability zone.
Prices are a reviewable snapshot, not a live quote. The founder must approve the provider and the budget before apply.
